title: Selected Mio in the game
caption: Selected Mio using her phone, laptop and desk keyboard, with native lunch contacts. Final highlights come first; the complete capture history follows in expandable sections. History frames follow capture order, including the ten final highlights again to keep each run complete. Older named contact checkpoints can be occluded or captured after release; held-detail views show the accepted contact proof.
